notes: Uses three relevant facts (margin, shipping, certificate), so reasons pass (rule 2). Germany's size is offered as a reason to keep going, not as a risk to the recommendation (rule 5).

responses.value: Don't ship to Germany yet. On a £35 order at a 40% margin we make £14, and German shipping is £14 plus £3 for the health certificate, so each order loses about £3. Germany's market is twice ours, so next I'd get quotes from a German grower to fulfil orders locally.
